QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Eremose's Gratitude
QuestInfo.0: When you return from your training, it's obvious Eremos has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: The data collection went well, and Eremos wants to send you out again for more. It's still unclear what exactly all of this information gathering is actually for and whether it's intended to benefit you or not. But, perhaps you don't need to know everything just yet.
